suggestedQuestions.suppliers: How do I find verified suppliers?
suggestedQuestions.registerBuyer: How do I register my business as a buyer?
suggestedQuestions.verifySeller: How do I become a verified seller?
suggestedQuestions.listProduct: How do I list a product?
suggestedQuestions.placeOrder: How do I place an order?
suggestedQuestions.contactSeller: How do I contact a supplier?
suggestedQuestions.accountIssue: I have an account issue — what do I do?

fallback.suppliers: Open the Verified suppliers page and use the 'Verified only' filter. Each badge links to a profile with their products.
fallback.registerBuyer: Click 'Join free' in the header, pick 'Register as a buyer', and fill in your business details.
fallback.verifySeller: After registering as a seller, open Verification in your dashboard and submit your business documents. An administrator reviews each submission.
fallback.listProduct: In your seller dashboard, open Add product. Fill in the name, category, MOQ, unit and indicative price.
fallback.placeOrder: Add products to your cart from any product card, then open the cart from the header and place the order request.
fallback.offlinePay: All Businesses does not take payment online. Buyer and seller agree a method (bank transfer, letter of credit, etc.) on their own terms.
fallback.contactSeller: Open the supplier's profile and tap Contact supplier or Request a quote.
fallback.accountIssue: Sign in and open Account settings. For a verification or document issue, use Report listing or Report business from the relevant profile.
